slides.title: Biological question and decision
bullets: Which pathway remains reproducible after donor adjustment?
Donor-balanced analysis reduced the apparent inflammatory signature.
Prioritise the reproducible receptor pathway for follow-up.
This is Omics target prioritisation, not proof of receptor causality.

Accession {{PRJ0011:lims_id}} anchors input provenance.

slides.title: Revision note: v3 FINAL_final
bullets: This revision puts donor-adjusted pathway prioritisation before the inflammatory interpretation.
The inflammatory signature is retained as a qualified observation, not the progression recommendation.
The receptor-pathway recommendation is the final conclusion of this saved readout.
slides.notes: Revision note, Dr T. Zawiernicki, 18 Dec 2023: retain the earlier inflammatory discussion as context; the donor-adjusted receptor-pathway recommendation governs the final model gate.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Data acceptance
bullets: Reconcile donor labels, sample identifiers and expression inputs.
Check library-level distributions before fitting biological contrasts.
Preserve missing metadata and exclusions in the analysis notebook.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Donor structure matters
bullets: Donor-associated expression can resemble a treatment or disease-associated signature.
Repeated material from a donor is not independent biological replication.
Keep donor identity attached to expression inputs through modelling.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Unadjusted interpretation
bullets: The initial interpretation emphasised an apparent inflammatory signature.
Without donor adjustment, donor composition can influence pathway ordering.
Retain this view as the comparator, rather than the final target ranking.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Adjusted analysis question
bullets: Estimate the biological contrast while accounting for donor structure.
Keep the accepted input set and contrast definition explicit.
Do not confound a changed model specification with newly generated experimental evidence.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Donor-balanced comparison
bullets: Use donor-balanced evidence to reassess the pathway interpretation.
Compare adjusted and unadjusted direction of effect.
Flag conclusions whose support depends on donor representation.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: What changed
bullets: The apparent inflammatory signature weakened after donor-balanced analysis.
The change reduces its priority as a general biological explanation.
Weakening does not demonstrate absence of inflammatory biology.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: What remains reproducible
bullets: The receptor pathway remains the reproducible priority.
Carry the pathway into a focused biological follow-up.
No specific receptor identifier is assigned without the source target card.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Pathway comparison at the gate
bullets: Inflammatory interpretation: retain with donor-dependence caveat.
Receptor pathway: progress on the reproducible adjusted interpretation.
Other candidate explanations: do not imply a rank unsupported by the supplied outcome.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Reporting conventions
bullets: Report expression contrasts as log2 fold change with adjusted probabilities.
Keep pathway definitions and annotation versions alongside contrasts.
This readout contains the qualitative decision; numerical pathway tables are not supplied.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Target-card requirements
bullets: Link the receptor-pathway target card to the adjusted contrast.
Record biological rationale separately from statistical association.
Carry donor sensitivity and assay feasibility into the follow-up decision.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Alternative explanations
bullets: Cell composition may contribute to pathway-level expression.
Correlated donor and biological terms limit attribution.
A reproducible pathway signal need not identify the direct intervention point.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Follow-up question
bullets: Does a targeted experiment support receptor-pathway involvement?
Define the perturbation and functional readout before observing the outcome.
Use donor-aware sampling in the follow-up design.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Follow-up design boundaries
bullets: Balance donor contribution across experimental conditions.
Include controls that distinguish functional response from viability loss.
Retain expression evidence as context for the functional readout.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Model uncertainty to retain
bullets: Residual donor effects may remain.
Pathway membership is annotation dependent.
Association does not establish therapeutic benefit or direction of intervention.
slides.footer: Quenverell Computational Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential
